# P37.38 — Disagreements browser

**Row:** 462 of 510 · `r11/P37.38-disagreements-browser` off `r11/P37.37-claim-viewer-v2`
**Contract:** `docs/tickets/462_P37.38__disagreements-browser.md`
**Requirement stamps:** **SIG-UI-071** (owned — spec §56 `Owner:`); UXR-21 (later-family draft — carried, never re-decided)
**ADR:** none (no owned decision — the surface implements landed contracts)

## What lands

- **`/disagreements/` hub + `/disagreements/place/<slug>/` pages** (T1,
  zero-JS) — one place page per emitted `sig.dossier-sources/1` doc; the
  page-type registry classifies `/disagreements/**` under owner P37.38.
- **Three typed kinds kept apart** (K12b I-11 / NEW-17, K13 §4.2):
  - *Recorded contradictions* — derived from the `sig.statement/1`
    `contradictions.contradiction_ids` + `competing_claim_ids` (P35.36's
    streams). Both sides render with source and observed/recorded dates,
    claim-page links where a claim view published, and place links from the
    dossier docs naming the record. An id-only record (no citing statement)
    still lists — typed absence, never dropped.
  - *Within-source coordinate conflicts* — `coordinate_conflicts_intra_source`
    per source, labelled identity defects until CONF-03b re-keys them; never
    merged into the contradiction kind.
  - *Declared-vs-located disagreements* — the
    `declared_here_located_elsewhere` / `located_here_declared_elsewhere`
    pair plus per-counterpart `placement.*` rows, resolved to names and
    place links — visible on BOTH dossier sides.
- **Counts from the release** — every count cites the dossier's own
  manifest-listed `web/dossier_sources/<slug>.json` (UXR-34 figure
  registry; SIG-TRANSP-040 parity with the sources explorer by
  construction), never a parallel count.
- **Links to entity and dossier sections (UXR-21 draft)** — contradiction
  records link subject entity pages where a `sig.entity-label/1` url
  exists; place pages link their dossier + sources explorer; each dossier
  page gains "All disagreements for <place> →" emitted only where a place
  page exists (R-6, never a 404).
- **Fixture alignment** — `statements-fixture` gains the portal side of
  `contra:device-count-42-38` (a fully-resolved two-sided record);
  `dossier-sources-fixture` names the same id on `usa`, `usa/ok` and
  `oklahoma-city`; `usa/tx` exercises the three typed absences.
